ambiguities_or_notes: Exact audited Russian Markdown source bytes were revalidated in this runtime against the pinned SHA-256.
Both printed page markers, the dated heading, complete diary body, French maxim, and all twelve notes are represented.
Гаонарею is normalized only at the lexical level to gonorrhea; Tolstoy's euphemistic 'from what it is usually got from' is kept rather than explained.
The step/left-foot/right-foot image and pronoun shifts in the solitude passage are retained instead of recast as polished philosophical argument.
French Les petites causes produisent de grands effets remains in the body; the note supplies Small causes produce great effects.
The crossed-out authorial footnote about societies containing more evil than good remains explicitly identified as Tolstoy's crossed-out footnote.
